models.purpose: Track how many people know a news item, across topical communities.
models.summary: The increment of informed people is a relevance factor times a sum over communities. Within a community the rate is beta; across communities it is eta. The paper orders them as beta_j < eta_ji < eta_ij < beta_i but never assigns numbers. R(t) rises and decays exponentially at a speed set by relevance, which runs from 1 to 10.

variables.definition: spread rate inside the matching community
number of people who know the item

governing_equations.source_expression: dy = R(t) * sum_i sum_j [beta_i*y_i + eta_ij*y_j] * (N_i - y_i) * dt
governing_equations.normalized_latex: \Delta y = R(t)\sum_i\sum_{j\ne i}[\beta_i y_i(t)+\eta_{ij} y_j(t)](N_i-y_i(t))\Delta t
governing_equations.purpose: informed count grows by within-community and cross-community terms

objectives: Track how many people know a news item, across topical communities.
constraints: an item has already cleared both news thresholds

parameter_estimation.method: rates ordered by inequality, not fitted

assumptions: topical distribution is uniform within an era

identifiability_feasibility.analysis: exponential decay fits are shown with R-squared, but the rates beta and eta have no values

validation_refs: mention-volume series for Lincoln, Monroe, Berlin Wall, Rickman
strengths: one relevance factor carries all four characteristics
limitations: rates are ordered but never given numbers
missing_details: the values of beta and eta are not reported

models.purpose: Update what each node believes and what it shares.
models.summary: A node notices a neighbor's message with probability PN, and the product over neighbors decides whether it absorbs the item. It shares only after a gestation period G, and only for one time step, enforced by a Kronecker delta. Forgetting is a second probability PV that drifts toward 1 as time passes. Printed states are 0 or 1.

variables.definition: chance a node registers a neighbor's message
chance a node passes the item on
delay before a node shares what it absorbed
internal belief and outward share of one node

governing_equations.purpose: outward share fires once, after the gestation delay

objectives: Update what each node believes and what it shares.
constraints: a node shares with all of its neighbors or with none

software: custom simulator, link given in appendix

assumptions: a node holds one string until another overrides it

identifiability_feasibility.analysis: simulated entertainment news of relevance 9 reproduces the shape of the Marilyn Monroe mention series

validation_refs: mention-volume series for Lincoln, Monroe, Berlin Wall, Rickman
strengths: one relevance factor carries all four characteristics
limitations: rates are ordered but never given numbers
missing_details: the values of beta and eta are not reported

models.purpose: Represent a slow connection without changing the node update.
models.summary: A ghost node sits between two real nodes and has notice and share probabilities fixed at 1. A connection of speed v is a ghost node with gestation period v-1, so a newspaper on a train takes v steps. The device lets one update rule cover both instant and delayed edges.

variables.definition: steps needed to cross one edge
gestation of the ghost node, v minus 1

governing_equations.purpose: slow edge represented as a ghost node gestation

objectives: Represent a slow connection without changing the node update.
constraints: a ghost node has exactly one inward and one outward edge

steps: insert a ghost node on each slow edge
software: custom simulator, link given in appendix

assumptions: notice and share probabilities of a ghost node are both 1

identifiability_feasibility.analysis: island-mainland runs use the delay to keep island news isolated

validation_refs: mention-volume series for Lincoln, Monroe, Berlin Wall, Rickman
